title: Enemy death feedback: element-tinted dissolve / burst when an enemy dies
description: Today enemies just queue_free on death with no payoff (game-feel: kills should land). Deliverables: (1) A death effect for the EmpireDrone (and reusable by Warden / future enemies): on Health.died, play a short dissolve/fade + a particle burst (reuse scripts/juice/impact_spark.gd or a dedicated death CPUParticles2D) tinted by the enemy's armor element color, optionally a final hit-stop/shake scaled to importance (small for a drone, larger for a boss). The drone should remove itself only after the effect (defer queue_free) so the burst is visible. (2) Keep it cheap and placeholder (particles + tween on the ColorRect). (3) Wire to the existing Health 'died' signal; do not change matchup/damage logic. Reserve the loudest death juice for the boss; routine drone deaths are modest (doctrine: budget juice). Tests-first (GUT pure logic): a pure death-effect tuning selector (burst amount / shake / hit-stop scaled by an 'importance' or max_hp input), and that the death path triggers exactly once at <=0 HP (no double-free). Follow Bash gotcha (never 'cd &&'; absolute --path; --import for new class_names). Verify headless clean + GUT exit 0, no regression.
acceptance_criteria: When an enemy's Health reaches 0 it plays an element-tinted dissolve/fade + particle burst before being removed (deferred free so the effect is visible), wired to the Health 'died' signal.
The death effect is reusable across enemy types and scales with importance (modest for a drone, louder for a boss) per the juice budget.
Death triggers exactly once at <=0 HP (no double-free / repeated effect); damage/matchup logic is unchanged.
GUT covers the death-effect tuning selector (scaled by importance/max_hp) and single-trigger-at-zero behavior.
Placeholder visuals only; full GUT suite passes headless exit 0 with no regression; project loads clean.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Built tests-first; reviewer (fresh) APPROVE with one MEDIUM, looped back to dev and fixed. On Health.died both drone and warden play an element-tinted burst (impact_spark, tinted by current armor) + DeathEffect-scaled shake/hit-stop + a dissolve tween (fade alpha + shrink); drone defers queue_free to the tween callback, warden does NOT free (arena victory owns the boss, BossHUD polls it live). Single-trigger triple-guarded (Health._dead + projectile _hit dedup + _dying/_won latch) — verified under overkill, CHAIN/PIERCE multi-hit, and re-emitted died. Pure DeathEffect.tuning_for(importance) scales modest(drone)->loud(boss), clamped. MEDIUM fix: _update_tint() was overwriting the dissolve alpha every physics frame; now early-returns on _dying/_won so the FADE actually renders — proven by new frame-stepping tests asserting sprite alpha drops <1.0 for both. GUT 288/288 exit 0, no parse errors / no ignored scripts, clean headless load. Not committed (no git repo).
